slices.title: Add missing task plan file to .eneik directory
slices.jtbd: When implementing the task plan file for this epic, I want to create the file with the required QA slice and linked wishlist IDs, so that the missing acceptance criteria are satisfied
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing task plan is missing a QA slice, When the plan is updated in the .eneik directory, Then the task plan includes a BARCAN-TAG-06 QA slice.
Given the task plan is updated, When the sourceIndex is validated, Then the plan correctly links to the wishlist ids in the payload.
Given the role completes the file creation, When the relevant verification command runs, Then the change passes without unrelated scope.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase task plan compliance rate to 100%
